name: Fey Healing, Mass Lesser
body:
School transmutation (healing); Level druid 5, magus 5, shaman 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, summoner 5, witch 5

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart
Duration 5 rounds + 1 round/level (max 15)

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions like lesser fey healing except it affects multiple targets.
